sources.title: Introducing efficiency focused "ThinkingCap" model series. | BottleCap AI
sources.snippet: One of our core aims at BottleCap is efficiency in AI. To fulfil this mission, we fine-tuned Qwen3.6-27B to reduce unnecessary reasoning while preserving answer quality.

sources.title: ThinkingCap-Qwen3.6-27B Cuts Reasoning Token Use by Half
sources.snippet: ThinkingCap-Qwen3.6-27B cuts reasoning token use by 50% while preserving much of Qwen's reasoning quality across key AI benchmarks.

sources.title: AIAny - ThinkingCap: Qwen 3.6 27B
sources.snippet: Fine-tuned variant of Qwen3.6-27B that cuts internal reasoning ('thinking') token usage by roughly 46% on average while preserving benchmark accuracy and safety behavior. Targets lower latency and inference cost; ships on Hugging Face with GGUF quantizations for local use.
